reason: The goal and introduction point directly to bringing the lane-born stars through the returning galaxy's outskirts.

choice.combine: Stars born in the dark lane
choice.with: Stellar outskirts of the returning galaxy

expectation: The stars will pass through the returning galaxy's stellar outskirts, likely without colliding.

effect: The crossing completed the goal and showed that the lane-born stars pass between other stars even though their parent gas collided.
reaction: The contrast between the gas and its stellar descendants was satisfying, though the outcome was largely expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Bringing the lane-born stars into the crossing was worthwhile because it made the contrast between colliding gas and passing stars concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: There was only one gameplay decision, and no passage stood out as particularly confusing or repetitive.

surprise.text: Nothing was especially surprising; the stars passing without surface collisions matched my expectation.

arbitrary.text: The action had a clear purpose: the goal explicitly asked for the stars to enter the crossing.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue to see how the surviving stars and planetary system fare as the galaxies merge, though this chapter alone offered little opportunity for a meaningful choice.
